subject: A question about yearly site covariates in pcountOpen()

messages.author: 92467f99580efdc0
messages.subject: A question about yearly site covariates in pcountOpen()
parts:
I am interested in estimating population trend across 39 sites separated in time by 3 years. Within a year, many replicate counts were made. Managed to construct the dataframe properly (I think) and got estimates from pcountOpen() that make sense based upon single time-period estimates.  I was trying to be clever and use an "exposure" covariate like that shown on page 256 of Kery and Royle.  I used an accumulated effort calculation for each site across multiple replicates so that each site had a corresponding effort value for the year, which differed between the two time periods due to how sites were selected to be surveyed (think panel-design). So, I used these as yearly site covariates and the coefficients returned make sense.  

Question: pcountOpen() returns estimates for each year for this exposure covariate. Is there a way to formulate a single effect so that only 1 parameter estimate for exposure is returned?  I am trying to avoid having to use a survey-specific covariate due to the awkward size of the problem.
